استأيكا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْيَكَا (istaʔyakā) /is.taʔ.ja.kaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
# اِسْتَأْيِكَا (istaʔyikā) /is.taʔ.ji.kaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
